name: COMFORT
recent: Comfort Gloves 与 IRB 达成 RM8.3m 税务和解，子公司撤回司法复核申请，所有法律程序已结束。公司公布截至 2026-09-30 季度业绩，录得应占利润 RM2.5m。
notable: 与 IRB 达成 RM8.3m 税务和解，结束所有法律程序。
子公司撤回针对 IRB 的司法复核申请。
公布截至 2026-09-30 季度业绩，应占利润 RM2.5m。
earnings: 截至 2026-06-30 季度，营收 RM90.716m，环比增长 33.7%，同比增长 12.9%；净利 RM1.311m，净利率 1.4%，较上季净利率 -9.4% 转正。

recent_en: Comfort Gloves reached an RM8.3m tax settlement with the IRB, and its subsidiaries withdrew judicial review applications, ending all legal proceedings. The company reported attributable profit of RM2.5m for the quarter ended 30 Sep 2026.
notable_en: Reached an RM8.3m tax settlement with the IRB, ending all legal proceedings.
Subsidiaries withdrew judicial review applications against the IRB.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026, with attributable profit of RM2.5m.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was RM90.716m, up 33.7% QoQ and 12.9% YoY; net income was RM1.311m with a net margin of 1.4%, turning positive from a net margin of -9.4% in the prior quarter.
